claim: Neither null has a data-allowed region (both nulls: G reaches 0.29 only at g 1.4-3.3, after S1 is lost at 1.15-1.36)
finding: Wrong for the weight-shuffled null at r 0 (allowed 0.84-1.15, 2 grid points) and r 0.25 (1.01-1.15, 1 point); the configuration null has none at any core r; neither null has one at r >= 0.5. The synthesis recheck had marked these rows n/a.

claim: Mean-field D agrees only at r 0; at r >= 3 it is 31-36% low; same over-inhibition as M1
finding: Agrees (within 10%) at r 0, 2.5 and 2.75 (3/23). Too high at r 0.125 (x1.96) and r 1.75-2.25 (x1.33-2.36), absent <= 30 at r 0.25-1.5, too LOW at r >= 3 by 19-35% (r 3: 0.81, r 4: 0.69, r >= 4.5: 0.65). Over-inhibition explains r 0.125-2.25 only; at r >= 3 the error has the opposite sign (and the meanfield lane flags its D values at r >= 1.75 as low-confidence).

claim: Noise-driven quasi-cycles at r <= 0.5 near the onset (section 3 table)
finding: On the real M2 graph OSC flags occur only at r 0 (7 points, g 1.149-1.305). The r 0.25 / 0.5 / 4 flags are weight-shuffled-null rows. The flags are threshold-marginal (C_peak 0.10-0.15 vs 0.10); with an unbiased-lag ACF my recomputation flags 9 real points (adds g 1.214, 1.329). The one real-graph OSC-strong value (coherence 0.78, 7 replicas, g 1.149) is -0.17 with the point estimate C(2P)/C(P): an estimator artefact.

claim: Oscillation finite-size check on the real graph is inconclusive
finding: Depends on the subsample family: the nature lane's pre-registered primary real family (uniform subsample) gives var ~ N^-1.19 at r 0 (quasi-cycle by rule); its AL-keeping families give -0.03 and +0.34 (labelled 'macroscopic' by its rule, but confounded by 2-4x AL over-coupling); the decay lane's AL-keeping check gave -0.57 (inconclusive). The nature lane summary omitted the two 'macroscopic' family results.

claim: Branching ratio at most 0.977 per unit (pulse) and 0.94 (driven), never within 0.01 of 1
finding: Time-base dependent. Per step (MODEL2 states |1 - m| < 0.01 without a unit; the nature lane tightened it to per unit): driven max m_step 0.988 (|1 - m| = 0.012; 4 real-M2 points >= 0.985), pulse max 0.995 (within 0.01 per step, but the criterion applies to the driven regime). No LHG marker under either convention, but per step the driven maximum misses the mark by only 0.002. m_step 0.988 = autocorrelation time ~16.6 units.
source: results/m2/nature/driven_branch.json; results/m2/nature/aval.json; results/m2/verify/verify.json branch (own MR estimator, identical m_step 0.98805)

claim: Palp-intact test passes only for g <= 0.186; failure marginal at the lower edge (about 10% at g 0.22)
finding: CONFIRMED with 256 new replicas on a fine grid, but restated: at every g with G >= 0.29 (0.216-0.243) the LATE residual S2' fails clearly (0.114 [0.112, 0.116] at g 0.216); the early residual S1' is marginal (0.096 [0.091, 0.102]). The palp limit is g ~0.20 (interpolated: 0.202 lane data, 0.201 rerun), not 0.186 (that is the last passing coarse grid point); the gap to the gain edge (0.216) is 7%. M2s sliver at r 0: 0.235 to 0.26 on the grid, up to ~0.30 by interpolation.

claim: KS bug in m2_obs.powerlaw_fit: pd3 and any other users of the old fit should recheck
finding: No production user other than the nature lane (which replaced it): grep finds powerlaw_fit only in m2_obs.py, m2_nature_aval.py (comparison), m2_smoke_check.py, m2_obs_test.py. pd3 never used it. No recheck needed.

claim: Theory predictions were written before the experiment results (implicit in the grading)
finding: Neither theory lane was blind: both were told to read STATE.md, which by 17:40 carried the decay/driven/modules/nature summaries. The stochastic lane disclosed this; the meanfield lane (plan ~17:40, predictions 19:43) states only that it opened no experiment file. The pre-registered point estimates failed anyway (x0.53-0.80, x1.41-2.28).

claim: Configuration-null FSS at r 0 fails the W-ratio cut narrowly (0.502 vs 0.5)
finding: My recompute 0.506; a bootstrap over the 3 graph seeds per size gives a 95% interval [0.47, 0.55] with P(ratio <= 0.5) = 0.39, so the pass/fail at the cut is undetermined by seed noise. The robust feature is the plateau of W for N >= 40k (0.143, 0.148, 0.136). Verdict 'inconclusive' unchanged.
